qt: to the Commission Stefano Cavedagna (ECR), Chiara Gemma (ECR), Lara Magoni (ECR) Subject:

Law No 112 of 22 June 2016 titled ‘Provisions on assistance for persons with serious disabilities without family support’ – the ‘Dopo di noi (‘After us’) law’ – introduced into Italian law specific protections for persons with severe disabilities when family support is not available. The definition of the basic standards remains the responsibility of the Italian State, while the regions define the planning guidelines, in preparation for disbursing the resources that make it possible to take action locally. The transparency of regional ‘Dopo di noi’ projects is therefore crucial for understanding the impact of EU policies in the field of health and consumer protection, especially for the most vulnerable groups. In light of the above: 1.
What was the total amount of funding allocated by the Commission to the ‘Dopo di noi’ project in the Emilia-Romagna region?
How were these funds allocated and used?
What is the envisaged duration of the funding and the monitoring measures implemented to ensure the effectiveness of the project?
